content: {"praised": ["Fun, intelligent, suspenseful sci‑fi with good special effects.", "Strong performances by Angela Bassett and James Spader.", "Sharp sets and cool lighting enhance visual appeal.", "Engaging characters and witty humor add charm.", "Well‑crafted action sequences keep audience engaged."], "criticized": ["Plot feels dull, lacking intensity and engagement.", "Story is copycat, rehashing familiar sci‑fi tropes.", "Long, awkward opening scenes drag pacing.", "Wooden crew characters feel flat and uninteresting.", "Overall film is tedious and boring."]}
